name: Lead response time
definition: Elapsed time from qualified lead receipt to first meaningful human response
guardrail: Exclude spam and system acknowledgements

name: Contact rate
definition: Share of workable leads with two-way contact
guardrail: Define workable lead before reporting

name: Qualified call booking rate
definition: Share of qualified inbound calls that book an appropriate appointment
guardrail: Do not reward unsafe or ineligible bookings

name: Appointment show rate
definition: Share of booked appointments that occur
guardrail: Separate customer cancellation company cancellation and no access

name: Diagnostic completion rate
definition: Share of eligible visits with required diagnostic evidence completed
guardrail: Requirements must match license role and job type

name: Discovery completeness
definition: Weighted share of required discovery fields confirmed
guardrail: Unknown is better than fabricated

name: Summary confirmation rate
definition: Share of proposals preceded by a buyer-confirmed needs summary
guardrail: Confirmation must be explicit in note or recording

name: Recommendation fit score
definition: Rubric score for traceability from evidence and priorities to recommendation
guardrail: Do not infer fit from sale outcome alone

name: Proposal presentation rate
definition: Share of proposal-ready opportunities presented synchronously when appropriate
guardrail: Exclude procurement-only submissions

name: Proposal completeness
definition: Share of proposals containing required scope exclusions price terms proof and next step
guardrail: Requirements vary by motion and jurisdiction

name: Estimate turnaround time
definition: Elapsed time from scope completion to estimate delivery
guardrail: Report median and percentile not average alone

name: Follow-up SLA attainment
definition: Share of promised follow-ups completed by the promised time
guardrail: Buyer-declined follow-up is not overdue

name: Quote win rate
definition: Share of decided quoted opportunities won
guardrail: Report open aging and no-decision separately

name: No-decision rate
definition: Share of mature quoted opportunities ending without a buyer decision
guardrail: Use a documented aging threshold

name: Loss reason coverage
definition: Share of lost or no-decision opportunities with verified primary reason
guardrail: Do not force a reason the buyer did not give

name: Average sold ticket
definition: Recognized sold amount per won opportunity
guardrail: Pair with margin and cancellation rate

name: Gross margin percentage
definition: Revenue less direct cost divided by revenue
guardrail: Use finance-approved cost definitions

name: Revenue per issued lead
definition: Recognized revenue attributable to issued workable leads
guardrail: Maintain attribution window and multi-touch rule

name: Cancellation rate
definition: Share of sold jobs canceled before eligible completion
guardrail: Separate customer rescission financing failure and company cancellation

name: Financing option disclosure rate
definition: Share of financed presentations with cash price total financed cost and required terms disclosed
guardrail: Legal review defines required fields

name: Complaint rate
definition: Substantiated sales complaints per 100 sold jobs
guardrail: Track all complaints separately from substantiation

name: Rework attributable to expectation gap
definition: Completed jobs needing rework due to documented sales scope or expectation failure
guardrail: Review jointly with operations before attribution

name: Membership attach rate
definition: Eligible residential jobs with an accepted membership
guardrail: Eligibility and value must be explicit

name: Membership renewal rate
definition: Renewable memberships that renew
guardrail: Separate involuntary payment failure

name: Commercial renewal rate
definition: Eligible commercial agreements renewed
guardrail: Track scope reduction and price change separately

name: Expansion rate
definition: Existing commercial accounts adding verified scope or locations
guardrail: Exclude inflation-only revenue change

name: Stakeholder coverage
definition: Share of critical buying roles with a verified person status and next action
guardrail: Unknown roles remain gaps

name: Mutual next-step rate
definition: Share of active opportunities with owner action date and buyer confirmation
guardrail: A seller-only reminder is not mutual

name: Stage aging
definition: Elapsed time an opportunity remains in current stage
guardrail: Define pauses and procurement holds

name: Bid hit rate
definition: Share of decided qualified bids awarded
guardrail: Do not mix negotiated and hard-bid work

name: Go no-go discipline
definition: Share of submitted bids that met documented qualification threshold
guardrail: Threshold should include capacity risk and relationship fit

name: Pipeline coverage
definition: Qualified pipeline value relative to period target
guardrail: Stage probabilities must be empirically calibrated

name: Forecast accuracy
definition: Absolute error between forecast and actual divided by actual
guardrail: Use a documented zero-actual convention

name: Campaign qualified response rate
definition: Recipients producing a two-way response that meets qualification
guardrail: Exclude unsubscribes and automated replies

name: Campaign opportunity rate
definition: Delivered recipients creating accepted opportunities
guardrail: Define accepted opportunity before launch

name: Unsubscribe or opt-out rate
definition: Delivered recipients requesting or triggering opt-out
guardrail: Honor suppression requirements immediately

name: Market signal confidence
definition: Weighted confidence assigned to a market claim based on evidence quality recency and agreement
guardrail: Never convert low-confidence signals to facts

name: Coaching transfer rate
definition: Share of selected field behaviors that improve after coached practice
guardrail: Use comparable pre and post samples
